notes: EmbeddingGemma 2 Transcribe, LiteRT form: the audio encoder of google/embeddinggemma-2 (rev 914f7f89; Gemma 4 audio tower + embed_audio) exported to raw LiteRT graphs with an fp16-safe rewrite of its RMSNorm sites (per-site 2^-k rescale, eps x 4^-k, rsqrt clamp, attention mask -30000; bit-identical to the float32 model in fp32), fp16 weights (FLOAT_CASTING on FC / CONV_2D / DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D), one signature per file (audio_30s / audio_10s: mel float32 [1, F, 128] + mask -> soft tokens [1, F/4, 512] + mask), plus reader v2 (a 6-layer transformer over the soft tokens, 19,573,762 parameters, trained with CTC on LibriSpeech 960 h: mlboydaisuke/EmbeddingGemma-2-Transcribe-Reader revision de224fd8, reader.pt sha256 d605f6fb…; the 200,000-word table FC and ARG_MAX in-graph; reader v1's inputs, outputs and file names) = speech to words on the phone. This file: eg2_audio_f16safe_fp16w_w10.tflite (589015376 B), sha256 = hf_stage FILES.sha256 of the upload set (no model file has moved since the reader v2 upload); every phone run below ran these bytes (sha256 lines in the evidence). Galaxy S26, the NPU form of the sample app (r15 build): the encoder on the NPU in 10 s windows (read from the app's JIT cache), the reader at GPU fp32 on its own LiteRT thread or serially (the hidden extra): the 54 min recording (its WER misses the line of +0.1 pt against the torch v2 path; whether the HTP's fp16 arithmetic or the 10 s windows cause it is not separated), the 20 fixtures on two threads and on one, and the take of the 54 min as the hold's first transcription; plus the GPU fp32 rows of the 11 fixtures that the auto window sends through the 10 s pair. The reader rows are in the reader_w10 record of the same date. Landed 2026-10-21: the file is on the Hub at mlboydaisuke/EmbeddingGemma-2-Transcribe-LiteRT (main 84f653a6a6334ecb739f6aaeb91f94fd13acc648 = the card commit of 2026-10-20 06:05:47 UTC, after the reader v2 upload af9fe50c); its LFS oid equals artifact_sha256 (anonymous API read 2026-10-21 15:19 JST).
